limitations: Same current image, rooted representation disabled/enabled; this does not isolate the combined gain from every historical change.
Four arms use one advancing chain. ABBA exposes order drift but does not establish statistical significance.
Canonical TPS uses fully contained integer gen_utime buckets, typically 599 seconds within each 600-second offering window.
Capacity, proof correctness, cleanup and reproducibility are separate decisions; require the recorded capacity verdict, not merely successful execution.
Session-stats is frozen by image ID but lacks a source-revision label, so harness reproducibility remains false.
Docker Desktop host-PID-derived cgroup, thread and device attribution is excluded. Docker stats are approximate sampled diagnostics; host metrics describe the whole host.
Candidate representation counts and normalized stage wall times are not canonical TPS or CPU time; concurrent and nested timers overlap.
Admission error counters count full-run physical parent attempts, including retries. Snapshot-change retries identify overhead, not lost transactions or a proven sole bottleneck.
Zero checkpoint rollback counters leave that runtime branch unobserved. SIGTERM exit143 confirms termination without SIGKILL, not graceful database flushing.
resource_sampling_limitations: Docker stats timestamps are integer seconds captured before the sampling call, at approximately two-second cadence; measurement-boundary attribution is approximate.
CPU percent is an interval sample, while memory is Docker's rounded used-memory display; these are sampled diagnostics, not exact CPU-time or RSS accounting.
Statistics weight each selected sample equally, not by elapsed time, and exclude samples timestamped outside the offering measurement window.
The offering measurement window can differ from the fully contained integer gen_utime buckets used for canonical TPS.
Missing unfinished-arm summaries are listed as skipped; source acceptance flags are preserved, not recomputed.

preparation_fix.change: Enable Docker init for genesis and validator services; the actual validator has no SIGTERM handler and would otherwise be PID 1.
preparation_fix.probe: Default-handler probe stopped with exit143 under init; without init stop timed out and forced exit137. Actual experiment transitions passed without OOM/SIGKILL.
preparation_fix.limitation: Does not prove graceful validator database flushing.
